title: Outpost HUD — T6 UI overhaul
brief: Redesign the game HUD for the Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer (kids 7-12, judges; phone-first, desktop too). Covers the locked T6 scope: mission banner, compact life-support meters, shared power-budget panel, SCAN action, real-DONKI storm feedback, tutorial overlay and game-over screen. Water/food/crop systems from the user's reference image are intentionally excluded (rejected at design lock).

artboards.title: Mission Console
artboards.tradeoff: Always-visible mission banner, chips and power drawer give the strongest guidance for young players; costs the most screen chrome over the 3D scene

artboards.title: Kid Arcade
artboards.tradeoff: Fat gauges, round SCAN button and storm splash maximize kid appeal and legibility from a couch; lowest info density and least precise values

artboards.title: Focus Telemetry
artboards.tradeoff: One-line status strip keeps the 3D scene clean and expands only under threat; weakest constant hand-holding — relies on kids noticing the strip
